name: Hellbound Honor Guard

items.name: Final Reward
items.text: When the hellbound honor guard is reduced to 0 Hit Points, a fiery fissure forms beneath their feet and a host of screeching devils pours forth to drag their souls to Hell. All creatures within a 5-foot emanation take 3d8 fire and 3d8 spirit damage (DC 29 basic Reflex save save), and all creatures within a 10-foot emanation must attempt a DC 29 Will save save or be Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure). The rift then immediately closes.

items.name: Opportunistic Strikes
items.text:
Trigger A creature within 5 feet uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

---
Effect The honor guard mobs the triggering creature, inflicting 2d6+9 bludgeoning plus 2d6 spirit damage (DC 29 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Crush the Spirit
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect The honor guard strikes with their maces against enemies in a 5-foot emanation, battering souls as well as bodies (DC 29 basic Reflex save save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d6+1 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 spirit damage

2 2d6+9 bludgeoning damage plus 2d6 spirit damage

3 3d6+12 bludgeoning damage plus 2d6 spirit damage

items.name: Vigor of the Damned
items.text:
Frequency once per round

Requirements The hellbound honor guard has only 2 segments

---
Effect On the edge of defeat, the honor guard calls a paean to Asmodeus for aid. The honor guard regains 3d8 healing Hit Points. As standard for troops reduced to 2 segments, they can't regain Hit Points above the lowest listed threshold.

text: Chelaxian nobles, military officers, and other dignitaries deemed deserving by House Thrune are sometimes granted the protection of a detail of these elite soldiers: unwavering champions of the Chelaxian military machine who have sworn themselves to Asmodeus in exchange for unmatched strength and resilience.
